releases.note: Desktop: care plans per printer model, "Not needed", and Parts to buy.

releases.name: Khayt v4.6.0
releases.note: Webhook delivery log, with Resend (Windows/Linux).

releases.name: Khayt v4.5.0
releases.note: Undo for queue moves (Windows/Linux).

releases.name: Khayt v4.4.2
releases.note: Fixed: a pay-later link asked for the whole price again (both apps).

releases.name: Khayt v4.4.1
releases.note: Desktop: quote-form requests with a STEP file can be taken in.

releases.name: Khayt v4.4.0
releases.note: Desktop: every figure on a printed invoice is in the invoice's own ink.

releases.name: Khayt v4.3.0
releases.note: Khayt looks different, and the sidebar is arranged by what you are doing.

releases.name: Khayt v4.2.2
releases.note: Desktop: a milestone invoice is a proforma for that part of the job.

releases.name: Khayt v4.2.1
releases.note: Desktop: the calculator says what a job for a client in another currency will be saved as.

releases.name: Khayt v4.2.0
releases.note: Desktop: HueForge is in Khayt, not only Bed Ready.

releases.name: Khayt v4.1.2
releases.note: Desktop: a cancelled job is no longer counted as open work.

releases.name: Khayt v4.1.1
releases.note: Desktop: a proforma is no longer a tax invoice with a new title. "Generate Proforma" used to draw the full invoice and then retitle it, so the paper still carried the ZATCA QR, quoted the invoice number in its payment QR, stamped a ZATCA id on the job, and could warn that the QR was not compliant.

releases.name: Khayt v4.1.0
releases.note: No change to Khayt itself.

releases.name: Khayt v4.0.0
releases.note: Desktop: version 4, to match Khayt for macOS.

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.35
releases.note: Desktop: licence warnings where a sale is edited.

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.34
releases.note: Desktop: an imported quote-form request opens costed, not at 0.

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.33
releases.note: Desktop: a quote-form G-code is imported, not left queued.

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.32
releases.note: Desktop: a quote-form request's model file is saved with the quote before the request is deleted.

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.31
releases.note: Desktop: the colour planner costs a print's time in hours, not minutes. "Add to calculator" in the multicolour planner passed the slicer's time in minutes where the calculator expects hours.

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.30
releases.note: Desktop: models archived on the Mac leave the desktop library too.

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.29
releases.note: Desktop: the Khayt Cloud plan picker says what happens to vault files over a smaller plan's limit. - It used to say "Nothing is deleted".

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.28
releases.note: WhatsApp Business campaigns now send a template Meta has approved, and only to customers who agreed to offers on WhatsApp.

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.27
releases.note: The catalogue now counts each part's quantity in a product's cost.

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.26
releases.note: A saved product price never changes on its own, since 3.11.25.

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.25
releases.note: VAT is now counted when the invoice is issued, not when the job is finished.

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.24
releases.note: A full customer erase takes their tracking pages down, since 3.11.23.

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.23
releases.note: Two security fixes, since 3.11.22.

releases.name: Khayt v3.11.22
releases.note: Khayt asks once about crash reports, and counts installs anonymously, since 3.11.21.
